title: Stop Babysitting Claude Code: Why Watching Every Step Is Wrong
description:
Everyone thinks you have to watch Claude Code every second, approve every step, and catch every mistake. I gave Opus 4.8 a plan for my business command center, hit go, and left to take my dog to the vet. It builds a team of agents that check each other's work, so it fixes its own mistakes while you are gone.
